provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.evidence.active_decisions against rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:record, rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:check, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:recording_rechecks_sources_even_with_an_existing_inventory, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:mismatch_and_inconclusive_reviews_never_count_as_correspondence, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:revised_review_can_supersede_same_unit_after_consulting_more_context, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:stale_supersession_cannot_fall_back_to_an_independent_positive_review. record reloads Inventory and validates current sources, rejects future notes/drafts, and requires same-unit existing superseded records. check computes active records and fails on any stale active decision or active mismatch/inconclusive outcome. The cited tests exercise cached-inventory changes, negative decisions alongside positive ones, same-unit supersession with added context and stale replacement without fallback. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
